t: Produce a good clean finish to the cut edges. For housing, grooving, mortising and performing plunge cuts. Non-Stick coated for better performance with minimised resin and heat build up. Extra long shanks. Ideal for cutting kitchen worktops.
b: Suitable for Cutting Softwood, Hardwood, Laminate, Veneer Wood, Plywood, Chipboard, Fibreboard & Sandwich Material
